# Docusign
> Docusign provides electronic signature, agreement lifecycle, and intelligent agreement management tools for creating, signing, automating, and managing agreements.

Docusign’s platform spans eSignature, contract and workflow automation, agreement analytics, identity and notarization, developer APIs, integrations, and customer support resources. This file highlights the most useful product, documentation, developer, and learning pages across docusign.com.

## Core Products
- [Explore All Products](https://www.docusign.com/products): Overview of Docusign’s agreement, signing, automation, and management product portfolio.
- [eSignature](https://www.docusign.com/products/electronic-signature): Send, sign, and track agreements with Docusign electronic signature.
- [Agreement Preparation](https://www.docusign.com/products/agreement-preparation): Prepare agreements with templates, document generation, and intake workflows.
- [Navigator](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/navigator): Store, search, manage, and analyze agreements across the organization.
- [Maestro](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/maestro): Automate agreement workflows with no-code orchestration and process routing.
- [Web Forms](https://www.docusign.com/products/web-forms): Collect data and generate agreements through reusable online forms.
- [Mobile App](https://www.docusign.com/products/mobile): Manage signing and agreement tasks from Docusign mobile applications.

## Intelligent Agreement Management Platform
- [Docusign IAM](https://www.docusign.com/products/intelligent-agreement-management): Overview of the Intelligent Agreement Management platform and its core capabilities.
- [Docusign Iris](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/ai): AI capabilities for extracting insights and assisting agreement workflows.
- [App Center](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/app-center): Discover apps and extensions that expand Docusign platform functionality.
- [Navigator](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/navigator): Central repository for agreement visibility, search, and analytics.
- [Maestro](https://www.docusign.com/products/platform/maestro): Workflow automation for agreement processes across teams and systems.
- [Integrations](https://www.docusign.com/integrations): Browse prebuilt integrations connecting Docusign with business applications.

## Signing, Notary, and Delivery
- [Electronic Signature](https://www.docusign.com/products/electronic-signature): Core signing product for digital agreement execution and tracking.
- [Electronic Notarization](https://www.docusign.com/products/notary): Remote online notarization and notarized agreement workflows.
- [SMS and WhatsApp Delivery](https://www.docusign.com/products/electronic-signature/features/sms-whatsapp-delivery): Deliver agreements through mobile messaging channels for faster completion.
- [Access Documents](https://apps.docusign.com/sign/access): Access and review documents sent through Docusign signing workflows.
- [Free Electronic Signature](https://www.docusign.com/products/electronic-signature/free-electronic-signature): Start signing documents electronically at no cost.
- [eSignature Features](https://www.docusign.com/products/electronic-signature/features): Explore signing, sending, authentication, and workflow features.

## APIs and Developer Platform
- [APIs](https://www.docusign.com/products/apis): Entry point for Docusign developer products and API capabilities.
- [Developer Center](https://developers.docusign.com/): Documentation, quickstarts, SDKs, and tools for building with Docusign APIs.
- [API Reference](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/reference/): REST API reference for Docusign eSignature endpoints and resources.
- [Developer Quickstarts](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/quickstart/): Guided setup for common eSignature integration scenarios.
- [SDKs](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/sdks/): Official SDK resources for supported programming languages and platforms.
- [Developer Support Center](https://developers.docusign.com/support/): Developer help resources, troubleshooting, and support options.
- [Postman Collections](https://www.postman.com/docusign): Public Postman workspace for testing Docusign APIs.

## Developer Guides and Use Cases
- [Embedded Signing](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/how-to/request-signature-in-app-embedded/): Implement in-app signing experiences using embedded recipient views.
- [Send an Envelope](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/how-to/request-signature-email-remote/): Send agreements for remote signature through email workflows.
- [Embedded Sending](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/how-to/embedded-sending/): Build custom sending experiences inside your own application.
- [JWT Authentication](https://developers.docusign.com/platform/auth/jwt-get-token/): Authenticate service integrations using JWT-based OAuth flows.
- [Authorization Code Grant](https://developers.docusign.com/platform/auth/authcode/): Use user-consent OAuth for web and interactive integrations.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.docusign.com/platform/webhooks/connect/): Configure Docusign Connect for event-driven integration workflows.
- [Responsive Signing](https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/esign101/concepts/responsive-signing/): Learn how responsive signing adapts documents for mobile-friendly signing.
